sources.title: HassanB4/warfarin-review-phase1-baselines · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the three mandatory Phase 1 baselines from WarfaRisk, a nine-phase reproducible ML pipeline for warfarin dose prediction on the public IWPC pharmacogenomic cohorts. These set the performance floor every later-phase model in the project is compared against — no model is reported as an improvement unless it beats the IWPC published equation below (MAE 9.177).
